output.question: What are C&S Wholesale Grocers' subsidiaries?
output.answer: As of 2026-11-11, C&S Wholesale Grocers' current official Family of Companies page identifies Davidson Specialty Foods, Hansen Distribution Group, Grocers Supply, and SpartanNash. C&S's August 13, 2026 release likewise describes Grocers Supply, Hansen Distribution Group, Davidson Specialty Foods, and SpartanNash as part of the C&S family. Winn-Dixie should not be counted as a current subsidiary based on that release: C&S described itself as the proposed majority owner and said the transaction was expected to close in early 2027.

key_facts.fact: C&S's official Family of Companies page lists Davidson Specialty Foods, Hansen Distribution Group, Grocers Supply, and SpartanNash.
C&S's August 13, 2026 corporate release identifies Grocers Supply, Hansen Distribution Group, Davidson Specialty Foods, and SpartanNash as part of the C&S family of companies.
C&S said its proposed transaction to become majority owner of Winn-Dixie was expected to close in early 2027, so Winn-Dixie was not yet a completed C&S subsidiary as of the source date.

passages.quote: Today, the C&S family of companies — including Grocers Supply, Hansen Distribution Group™, Davidson Specialty Foods and SpartanNash® — delivers innovative supply chain solutions, products and services to chain, independent and military customers from 60 distribution centers nationwide.

C&S Wholesale Grocers, LLC (C&S) has announced a proposed transaction to be the majority owner of The Winn-Dixie Company (Winn-Dixie). Previously in 2025, C&S, as part of a consortium of private investors, acquired Winn-Dixie from ALDI U.S. The transaction is expected to close in early 2027.

caveats: C&S's public page presents a family-of-companies list rather than a formal legal entity schedule, so this should not be treated as an exhaustive list of every subsidiary legal name.
C&S's August 2026 release says Winn-Dixie was a proposed majority-owned company with closing expected in early 2027; its status could change after the as-of date.

A September 22, 2025 C&S release also mentioned FreshKo Produce Services and The Davidson Specialty Food Group, but the current Family of Companies page and August 2026 release use the four-name list above.
